# Darkvision (`spells:darkvision`)
**Level 2 [Transmutation](../magic-schools/transmutation.md)** | **Casting Time:** Action | **Range:** Touch
**Components:** V, S, M (a dried carrot) | **Duration:** 8 hours | **Classes:** [Druid](../classes/druid.md), [Ranger](../classes/ranger.md), [Sorcerer](../classes/sorcerer.md), [Wizard](../classes/wizard.md)

For the duration, a willing creature you touch has Darkvision with a range of 150 feet.
